notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]We worked on making you play the game better...[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Patch Notes & Developer Update[/b] 🎮[/p][p]Thank you all for playing and supporting our game. We are carefully reviewing every negative review and bug report to improve the overall experience. Your feedback is invaluable, and we are committed to making the game better with each update.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Recent Fixes & Improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]✅ Fixed various sound issues.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Resolved the bug where the game wouldn't restart after all survivors died.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed the issue where sound volume settings were not saving properly.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Applied additional settings to improve [b]optimization[/b] and [b]stability[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue working actively to resolve any remaining issues. Please keep sharing your feedback and reports. For direct communication, feel free to join our [b]Discord server[/b]. We're always listening! 💬[/p]

notes.title: Lastbane Early Access Release
notes.content:
[p][b]🎮 Lastbane Is Now Live — Join the Horror! 🔥[/b][/p][p]Hello survivors,[/p][p]We’re thrilled (and a little terrified) to finally welcome you to the world of [b]Lastbane[/b] — our latest and most intense horror game experience to date.[/p][p]From the depths of the unknown, twisted nightmares await those brave enough to enter. As you begin your journey through the terror-filled environments of Lastbane, we want you to know: [b]we're right here with you[/b].[/p][p]🚨 [b]We're Actively Monitoring Bugs & Issues[/b][/p][p]As with any fresh launch, we know some of you may run into bugs or unexpected problems. Please rest assured — [b]our team is on standby, ready to tackle issues as quickly as possible[/b]. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, and we're already working behind the scenes to ensure you get the smoothest and scariest experience possible.[/p][p]💬 [b]Need Help or Want to Report Something? Join Our Discord![/b][/p][p]We're keeping an open line of communication with our players. If you encounter a problem, want to share feedback, or just want to connect with the community, [b]please head over to our official Discord server[/b]. It’s the best place to reach us directly and stay up to date with fixes and upcoming updates.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://your-discord-link-here.com"]Join the Discord[/url] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/9aMQgBZWsQ"]https://discord.gg/9aMQgBZWsQ[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting Lastbane. We can’t wait to see your reactions, hear your stories — and maybe even your screams. 💀[/p][p]Stay alert. Stay alive.
– The [b]Lastbane Developer[/b][/p]
